Package neqsim.process.fielddevelopment.wellplanning

Class TubingMovementCalculator

java.lang.Object
neqsim.process.fielddevelopment.wellplanning.TubingMovementCalculator
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public class TubingMovementCalculator extends Object implements Serializable
Tubing movement and load calculator for a vertical completion string (Lubinski and Mitchell formulation).

For a change in internal and external pressure and average temperature the free-packer length change is the sum of

  • piston effect dL1 = -L F / (E A_s), F = (A_p - A_i) dP_i - (A_p - A_o) dP_o at the packer
  • ballooning dL2 = -2 nu L (dPi_avg - R^2 dPo_avg) / (E (R^2 - 1)), R = OD / ID
  • temperature dL3 = alpha L dT
  • helical buckling dL4 = -r^2 F_f^2 / (8 E I w_e) when the fictitious force F_f (compression) exceeds the helical threshold 2 sqrt(2) * 2 sqrt(E I w_e / r)

For a fixed packer the restrained length change gives an axial force change of -E A_s (dL1 + dL2 + dL3) / L; a travel-limited seal assembly restrains only the part beyond its stroke. A von Mises (triaxial) check with Lame hoop and radial stresses at the inner wall is provided for the combined load.

Limitations: vertical well, uniform properties, no friction or bending in deviated sections, no initial landing force history, no thermal gradient along the string beyond the average temperature change. Validation is by closed-form hand calculations only; it is a screening and not a WellCat or StressCheck replacement.
